name: agints-docs
description: Big Documents Agent by Agints.com helps investigate private documents with cited evidence, add local files through a secure uploader, search manually, and scan library metadata.

interface.longDescription:
Answers from your documents, powered by Agints.com. Search your private manuals, policies, and SOPs to find a page or answer a question. Page citations point to passages you can check. Get a clear notice when a source is missing or unclear, with a prompt to identify the document.

Add documents at https://docs.agints.com/agent. PDF, TXT, and MD files are supported. Portal sign-in is separate; attaching a file to a chat does not add it to your persistent library.

Self-service limits: 20 MiB per file, up to 1,000 PDF pages and 2 million extracted characters per file, and 100 files and 500 MiB total per account. PDFs need selectable text; scanned PDFs must be OCR’d before upload.

Larger collections need assisted planning at https://docs.agints.com/large-libraries; they are not available through automatic self-service upload.
defaultPrompt: Find and show page 896 in an uploaded document.
Find the exact HR sick-leave policy for employees on probation. Cite the page.
Show any SOPs for a medical claim over the coverage amount. Cite the pages.
